questions.question: Rahul invests his savings, which is Rs. 25,000 in his bank that pays 7 per cent annual interest. How much will he earn by way of interest in one year?
questions.solution:
Principal = Rs.25,000

Interest rate = 7%

Time period = 1 year

Interest for one year = 25000 × 7 ÷ 100 = Rs.1750

Hence, the interest for one year is** Rs.1750.**

In the given Venn diagram, the 'Triangle' represents 'females', 'Circle' represents 'graduates'; the 'Rectangle' represents 'Employed' and the 'Square' represents 'Youth(under 30 years)'. The numbers given in the diagram represents number of persons of that particular category.

Circle → Graduates

questions.question: Four numbers have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.solution:
Except for 340, all other numbers are divisible by 3. 

To check if a number is divisible by 3 or not, see if the sum of the digits of the number is divisible by 3 or not.

3 + 6 + 0 = 9 (divisible by 3)

2 + 3 + 4 = 9 (divisible by 3)

3 + 4 + 1 = 8 (not divisible by 3)

1 + 2 + 3 = 6 (divisible by 3)

Hence,** ****341** is different from the other three.

questions.question:
If '+' means divided by, '-' means 'add', '×' means 'minus' and '÷' means multiplied by, what will be the approximate value of the following expression?

[{(11 × 2) - (2 ÷ 2)} + (3 - 2)] ÷ 2
questions.solution:
According to the question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5c2df46760cb50708b5a8a2527d9fb4706a64e909850ca7c23a8f56cd69cb0e.png] 

[{(11 × 2) - (2 ÷ 2)} + (3 - 2)] ÷ 2 

[{(11 - 2) + (2 × 2)} ÷ (3 + 2)] × 2

⇒ [{9 + 4} ÷ 5] × 2

⇒ [13 ÷ 5] × 2

⇒ 2.6 × 2 = 5.2

Hence, **5.2 **is the outcome of the given equation.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement:**

1. All eggs are needles.

2. All grapes are needles.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some needles are eggs.

II. Some grapes are eggs.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusions I nor II follow
either conclusions I nor II follow

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb682d76d64a76cd28148120204bd815f67dff1c62f27de24a55bf686d835a50.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some needles are eggs → True (As all eggs are needles, some needles are definitely eggs)

Hence, **only conclusion I follows.**
